pr_title: Stop opening indexes to only check if they exist
pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #4784

## What does this PR do?
- Added index_exists function in the index_scheduler.
- Resolved opening indexes to only check if they exist.
- Made changes to existing tests to test this function.

## PR checklist
Please check if your PR fulfills the following requirements:

- [x] Have you read the contributing guidelines?
- [x] Have you made sure that the title is accurate and descriptive of the changes?

Thank you so much for contributing to Meilisearch!

issue_context.title: Stop opening indexes to only check if they exists
issue_context.body:
We must not open indexes to check if an index exists but rather use a new method to do that **without** loading the index in memory.

https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/05cc2d1fac7554b8210086ccccd524010511dc00/meilisearch/src/routes/indexes/documents.rs#L306-L308
comments:
@Kerollmops 
I used the existing function from index_mapper which is 
https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/main/index-scheduler/src/index_mapper/mod.rs#L483
which is in turn using the get function from databases.
https://github.com/meilisearch/heed/blob/main/heed/src/database.rs#L342
I see that get function from database.rs will be decoding the content which we don't need for this use case.
I think it would be more easier and faster if we can create index_exists function in the database.rs which skips the decoding part.
If it isn't necessary my PR should suffice for now.

Thanks,
Bala.
